rules: Pure Rust: #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in domain & core engine. Zero bundled or vendored third-party C libraries (no OpenSSL, SQLite, FFmpeg, aws-lc-sys, or cmake builds). Audio decoding, storage, and DSP are pure Rust; TLS is rustls whose ring crypto provider is the one documented C/asm exception. Thin host OS platform -sys bindings are governed strictly by scripts/pure_rust_allowlist.txt.
Hexagonal architecture: domain and core engine never import concrete adapters; adapters implement ports.
Audio thread isolation: the real-time CPAL audio output callback must NEVER allocate memory, perform system calls, access the file system, or wait on locks.
Deterministic resource bounds: steady-state idle CPU < 0.2%, active playback CPU < 1.0%, base memory footprint <= 35 MB.
Plan first: all work tracked in .claude/plans/PLAN-NNN-*.md and .claude/tasks/TASK-NNN-*.md before code implementation.
Tests first: write failing unit/integration tests before writing implementation code.
Report progress through the Nexus tools; never edit the Nexus database or task states by hand.
Document all public types, structs, traits, and functions with clear docstrings.
